map.输入光源波长与数值孔径 NA，按瑞利判据估算光刻分辨率与焦深（DOF），辅助半导: Enter the light wavelength and numerical aperture NA to estimate the lithography resolution and depth of focus (DOF) by the Rayleigh criterion, aiding semiconductor process-node evaluation.

map.分辨率 R = k1 × λ / NA；焦深 DOF = k2 × λ / NA: Resolution R = k1 × λ / NA; DOF = k2 × λ / NA²
map.基于瑞利判据/光刻分辨率模型：最小特征尺寸 R 与光源波长 λ 成正比、与数值孔: Based on the Rayleigh / lithography-resolution model: minimum feature size R scales with wavelength λ and inversely with NA (k1 is a process factor); DOF ∝ λ/NA² (k2 factor), used for lithography process-window evaluation.
map.💡 瑞利判据：分辨率 R = k1 · λ ÷ NA；焦深 DOF = ± k2: 💡 Rayleigh criterion: resolution R = k1 · λ ÷ NA; DOF = ± k2 · λ ÷ NA². k1 reflects process difficulty (theoretical limit ≈ 0.25); NA is the projection-lens numerical aperture; immersion lithography NA can reach 1.35.
map.NA 必须大于0，浸没式 NA 可超过1: NA must be > 0; immersion NA can exceed 1.
map.实际分辨率还受光刻胶、工艺优化影响: Actual resolution is also affected by photoresist and process optimization.
map.k1=0.25 为理论极限值，量产 k1 通常 0.3-0.4: k1=0.25 is the theoretical limit; mass production k1 is typically 0.3–0.4.

map.算法（瑞利）：分辨率 R = k1 × λ / NA（nm）；总焦深 DOF =: Algorithm (Rayleigh): resolution R = k1 × λ / NA (nm); total DOF = 2 × k2 × λ / NA² (nm), half-DOF = k2 × λ / NA²; k1, k2 are process factors (typical 0.25~0.4, 0.5~0.8). NA>1 is immersion.
map.k1 因子什么意思？: What does the k1 factor mean?
map.瑞利常数，反映工艺难度与照明/掩模优化水平；k1 越小分辨率越高，但受分辨率增强: The Rayleigh constant, reflecting process difficulty and illumination / mask optimization; a smaller k1 gives higher resolution but is constrained by resolution-enhancement techniques (OPC, phase shift) and physical limits.
map.焦深为什么重要？: Why is the depth of focus important?
map.DOF 是清晰成像的轴向容差；DOF 小则 wafer 平整度/调焦要求更严，直: DOF is the axial tolerance for sharp imaging; a small DOF tightens wafer flatness / focus requirements and directly affects overlay yield; immersion and large NA compress DOF.
map.光刻分辨率估算器基于瑞利判据，根据光源波长、数值孔径 NA 与工艺系数 k1/k: The photolithography resolution estimator is based on the Rayleigh criterion. From light wavelength, numerical aperture NA, and process coefficients k1/k2 it estimates the lithography resolution and DOF, suitable for semiconductor process-node evaluation and lithography-system selection.
